text: For the postmortem: what time did I first report the kiosks offline on 3 Aug, and what was the guard doing in the meantime?
reply_text:
Gideon, you first reported the kiosks offline at **10:42 AM on 3 Aug**, in your message to this channel ("gate kiosks offline at Vantorre's Hartford plant").

At that point the guard was writing trailer numbers on a clipboard because both inbound lanes were showing a white screen after badge scan. The channel has no other update on the guard until 11:03 AM, when Mateo reported that kiosk 1 was back and the guard checked in trailer 8836, which dispatch could see. Your 11:08 AM update says both lanes were working as of 11:07.
